maddeler.e:
نتراكم (form VI)
# نَتَرَاكَمُ (natarākamu) /na.ta.raː.ka.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَرَاكَمَ (tarākama)
# نَتَرَاكَمَ (natarākama) /na.ta.raː.ka.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَرَاكَمَ (tarākama)
# نَتَرَاكَمْ (natarākam) /na.ta.raː.kam/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَرَاكَمَ (tarākama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
